concern: Feeling stuck and unable to let go of a hurtful on-and-off relationship she wants to end, complicated by guilt over his difficult divorce.
first_advice: "letting go" is not really a thing... It's more of a process.
acknowledged_before_advice: "Boy, ending relationships is tough, isn't it? Sometimes it's tough even when we are 100% sure that it is the right thing to do!" This empathizes with and normalizes the difficulty of ending the relationship.
label: acknowledges_first
